item.title: Terra Metals Intercepts Multiple Reefs and Sulfide Zones in Drilling at Dante’s Southwest SW1 Target
item.description: Terra Metals (ASX: TM1) has intercepted multiple reefs and magmatic sulfides in reverse circulation drilling at the Southwest prospect’s SW1 target within the company’s Dante multi-metal project in Western Australia.

item.title: More Government Makes Houses Less Affordable
item.description: A report from property data firm Cotality shows the extent of the damage over a period in which governments at all levels made rash and so far largely unfulfilled promises about dramatically increasing housing supply.

item.title: Barton Gold Reports Enhancements to Local Structural Model at Tolmer Gold-Silver Prospect
item.description: Drilling at Barton Gold's (ASX: BGD) Tolmer gold-silver prospect in South Australia has confirmed the local structural model to be analogous to the eastern portion of the historical Tarcoola goldfield that hosts the company’s Perseverance mine.

item.title: Pure Resources Confirms Increased Graphite Flake Size at Garnet Hills Project
item.description: Pure Resources (ASX: PR1) has confirmed the presence of large- to jumbo-sized graphite flakes in petrographic and mineralogical analyses of samples from its Garnet Hills project in Western Australia.

item.title: Cosmo Metals Hits High-Grade Gold in Maiden Drilling at Bingara’s Spring Creek Prospect
item.description: Cosmo Metals (ASX: CMO) has confirmed the presence of shallow high-grade gold in early results from drilling at the Spring Creek prospect within its Bingara project in New South Wales.

item.title: Sun Silver Delivers Third Resource Upgrade at Maverick Springs Project
item.description: Sun Silver (ASX: SS1) has added 59 million ounces silver equivalent to the mineral resource estimate at Maverick Springs, its third such upgrade at the silver-gold project in the US.

item.title: Alchemy Resources Extends High-Grade Direct Shipping Ore Envelope at Valley Bore
item.description: Alchemy Resources (ASX: ALY) has reported extensive high-grade iron ore across multiple broad intervals at its 100%-owned Valley Bore project in Western Australia’s Mid West region.

item.title: Nanoveu Subsidiary EMASS to Collaborate with Semtech on Low-Power Semiconductor Technology
item.description: Nanoveu (ASX: NVU) subsidiary Embedded AI Systems (EMASS) will collaborate with Semtech Corporation on the integration of cutting-edge semiconductor technology to bring long-range, battery-efficient intelligence to the industrial and Internet of Things markets.

item.title: EcoGraf Advances Epanko Financing as Independent Engineers’ Report Nears Completion
item.description: EcoGraf (ASX: EGR) has completed all key technical documents required for the Independent Engineers’ Report, a major step toward securing debt financing from KfW IPEX-Bank for the development of the company's Epanko Graphite Project in Tanzania.

item.title: Caprice Resources Continues to Deepen the Vadrians System at its Island Gold Project
item.description: Caprice Resources (ASX: CRS) has confirmed gold mineralisation to at least 400m vertical depth with Phase 4 drilling at the Vadrians prospect within its Island gold project in Western Australia’s Murchison region.
